mechanism: Both drugs can reduce glomerular filtration rate and impair renal function, with valganciclovir's active metabolite ganciclovir requiring renal clearance and irbesartan affecting renal hemodynamics.
action: Monitor renal function (creatinine, eGFR) regularly; adjust valganciclovir dosing based on creatinine clearance; ensure adequate hydration and assess blood pressure control.
